fields.statement: Change set 01M6MM3 (guides show stdin form for run findings) serves no intent yet. Which intent should it serve? Recent run-reliability fixes (e.g. #259 scoped tests, #267 run abandon) serve milestone-25, whose point is the daemon building and shipping the backlog on its own; a stalled permission prompt in a run is exactly what blocks that. / `rhiza run findings` and `rhiza run verdict` both already accept `-` for stdin. The build, review and plan-review guides show `<file>` for both. Which commands should the guides switch to the stdin heredoc form? / How should the change be tested?
